description: A peak-reading level meter for two channels, with the level printed in decibels under each bar

inputs.text: The signal shown on the left meter
The signal shown on the right meter

notes: 0dB on the meters is 10V peak, a 20V peak-to-peak signal, and the scale bottoms out at -96dB
each channel goes through a two-pole highpass filter at 10Hz before the meter, so direct current does not lift the reading on a small signal
scroll over either meter to move its own reference level, -60dB to 24dB in 1dB steps; the printed number shifts by that much and turns red while the reference is not 0dB
the peak marker is held for one second after the peak that set it
